content: आत्मना {%ind.%} (<ab>instr.</ab> of आत्मन्) Used reflexively; अथ चास्तमिता त्वमात्मना <ls>R. 8. 51</ls> thou thyself; आत्मना शुकनासमादाय <ls>K. 293</ls>. It is <ab>oft.</ab> compounded with ordinal numerals; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} {@˚द्वितीयः@} second including himself, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} himself and one more; so {@˚तृतीयः@} himself with two others; .{@-˚सप्तमः@} Being oneself the seventh; आत्मना सप्तमो राजा निर्ययौ गजसाह्वयात् <ls>Mb. 17. 1. 25</ls>.
